# RETIRED e2e scripts — bd-udjrq / bd-smxdr follow-on.
#
# A third category beside "invoked" and "orphaned". An entry here is a script
# that is deliberately not wired because something else already runs the same
# assertions. It is NOT a place to put an inconvenient orphan.
#
# FORMAT — three pipe-delimited fields, all required:
#   <script> | <covering command> | <assertion coverage lost>
#
# The audit enforces all four of these, so the justification is machine-checked
# rather than prose a reviewer has to take on faith:
#   1. the script must still be un-invoked — if something now calls it, it is
#      not retired, and the line must be deleted
#   2. it must NOT also appear in orphan_baseline.txt — no double-booking
#   3. the covering command must be a literal that actually appears in
#      .github/workflows/ci.yml or scripts/verify.sh — naming a command that
#      runs nowhere is exactly the failure this whole audit exists to catch
#   4. assertion coverage lost must be exactly `none`
#
# If you cannot name a real covering command, the script stays ORPHANED and the
# gate stays red. That is the intended outcome, not a gap.
#
# This does not loosen the orphan ratchet: orphan_baseline.txt still only
# shrinks, and moving a line here costs you a named, verified covering command.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The mesh campaign wrappers (7).
#
# These contain NO assertions. Each is a 29-63 line RCH dispatch wrapper that
# emits scenario events and then shells out to a cargo test target, refusing to
# run at all when `rch` is absent (exit 2). The assertions live in src/mesh
# unit tests and in tests/integration_g_m.rs, both of which CI already runs.
#
# Retiring them loses zero assertion coverage. What it does lose is the
# RCH-remote execution posture and the per-scenario outcome events — real, but
# not coverage, and not worth importing RCH's flakiness into the readiness gate.
#
# Files remain on disk. Deletion needs the operator's explicit permission
# (AGENTS.md RULE 1) and has not been given.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
e2e_mesh_admission.sh | cargo test --workspace --lib --jobs 1 mesh:: | none
e2e_mesh_anti_entropy_protocol.sh | cargo test --workspace --bins --tests --examples | none
e2e_mesh_peer_enrollment.sh | cargo test --workspace --bins --tests --examples | none
e2e_mesh_privacy_redaction_authorization.sh | cargo test --workspace --bins --tests --examples | none
e2e_mesh_replay_convergence.sh | cargo test --workspace --bins --tests --examples | none
e2e_mesh_selective_sync.sh | cargo test --workspace --bins --tests --examples | none
e2e_mesh_share_preview.sh | cargo test --workspace --bins --tests --examples | none
